gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Noto Sans Old Turkic reads friendly and chunky, its tall lowercase and open-mouthed curves never crowding each other on a plain sans frame. Oxanium's pen-pressure-free lines sit above it.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Noto Sans Oriya keeps its curves generously gapped, with small letters rising nearly to capital height. Oxanium sits above it like letters bent from a single length of wire, firm and distinctive.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-osage: Big, bold and rounded in the best way. Noto Sans Osage fills each line with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves, while Oxanium holds its monoweight skeleton overhead.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Noto Sans Osmanya turns its s shapes with wide, easy bends, and its lowercase looks oversized beside its own capitals. Oxanium's swell-free strokes head the page.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Oxanium looks cut from one gauge of tubing, every stem and curve matching, with a commanding presence. Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong is the quieter one, a sans with a high-set x-height and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Curves and straights sharing a single width give Oxanium its engineered, commanding look, and it earns its keep big and short. Noto Sans Palmyrene follows in compressed form, its curves stopping short instead of closing in.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa reads friendly and see-through. Its gentle step up from small letters to capitals keeps a long page easy, while Oxanium draws every heading stroke at one thickness.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Noto Sans Phoenician brings s curves that open wide at both ends and a generous lowercase height. Oxanium commands above it, its line width never swelling or tapering across the heading.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pahl: Oxanium has a laser-cut look, as if one cutting width carved every letter. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi reads gently beneath it, with gaping mouths on the e and capitals that barely rise.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Oxanium's wire-bent s curves never thin at the spine. Noto Sans Rejang then opens its lowercase counters like wide glass portholes, so a long page of sans text feels easy to enter.
